title: Digging Potatoes on Heber Hatfield's Property, Somerville
description: Digging potatoes on Heber Hatfield's property in Somerville. Over time, horse-drawn mowers, iron plows, and mechanical reapers were replaced by tractors and gasoline engines. These powered sawmills and water pumps. Small farms of 100 acres often needed two full-time employees and seasonal workers for harrowing, planting, spraying, and harvesting.
